keys.swarm.aura_rune_circle_desc: Runes appear where you stood 2 seconds ago, then explode under whatever followed you.
keys.swarm.aura_rune_circle_ten: Sigil of Ash: a huge sigil burns under the biggest crowd.
keys.swarm.aura_wisp_familiars_desc: Wisps fly off on their own to hunt single monsters, then come back to you.
keys.swarm.aura_wisp_familiars_ten: Will-o'-the-Wisp Choir: a choir of 10 wisps.
